card.title: One Last Thing
card.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, could you check this window latch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you show me which switch? There are several.

mechanism: A keeps a departing person engaged by converting each solved household question into another small request.
confusable: Unlike a single legitimate help request, the next task must arise exactly when B finishes and could leave.
comparison: D26-a follows latch to curtain to fan switch; D26-b follows drying to shelving to a conversation with the taxi driver.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
